sn55.33:1.3: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.33:1.4: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.33:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti, udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
sn55.33:3.3: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārāti.
